title: 深層ギルド
common: western high fantasy adventurer, octopath traveler inspired, slender angular body, slightly long proportions, anime style, exaggerated class silhouette (hat, collar, weapon)

characters.name: 戦士
characters.role: 前衛。肩当てと胸当て、短い陣羽織、金属の草摺。男
characters.prompt: male warrior, brown hair, steel pauldrons and breastplate #c8d2e0, short red surcoat #d8403a, metal tassets skirt, open-face helmet, longsword with gold hilt, confident grin

characters.name: 騎士
characters.role: 盾役。全身鎧、紋章の陣羽織、マント。女
characters.prompt: female knight, blonde hair, full silver-white plate armor #e8ecf4, blue tabard with crest #3a6ad0, long blue cape, round blue shield with gold boss, stern noble face

characters.name: 侍
characters.role: 西洋の街に来た異国の剣士。大袖、帯、幅広の袴。男
characters.prompt: male samurai, black hair tied back, navy kimono #3a4a8a with large armored sleeves, white undergarment, red obi belt, wide hakama, straw kasa hat, katana, calm sharp eyes

characters.name: 武闘家
characters.role: 素手の前衛。腕を出した道着、帯の結び目。女
characters.prompt: female martial artist, black short hair, sleeveless orange gi #f09a30, black belt knot, metal forehead guard, fist wraps and knuckle gauntlets, energetic fighting stance

characters.name: 忍者
characters.role: 速さの職。体に沿った装束、長い襟巻き。男
characters.prompt: male ninja, dark navy tight outfit #3a3a4e, long flowing red scarf #c83a3a, hood and face mask, red eyes, short ninjato, crouching ready pose

characters.name: 盗賊
characters.role: 罠と鍵。短い上着、なびく襟巻き、腰の小物入れ。男
characters.prompt: male thief, messy grey-black hair, red headband, short green jacket #5a7a4a, yellow scarf #e8b030, pouches on belt, dagger, sly smile

characters.name: 狩人
characters.role: 弓の後衛。矢筒、短いマント、革の上着。女

characters.name: 魔法使い

characters.name: 僧侶
